name: 面向合同装配的 Icertis 集成 (6V2)
name_en: Integration to Icertis for Contract Assembly (6V2)
description_en_html:
Overview

With Enterprise Contract Management, you can integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system with external contract assembly product Icertis Contract Intelligence. This integration enables users to create and manage legal content that is generated out of various business scenarios in a company, such as procurement processes, sales, policies, or intercompany agreements. The users can further collaborate on the document until it's agreed on by all the internal and external stakeholders and ready for execution through signature.

Key Process Flow

  • Assemble contract from template
    • Create a transaction to act as a source of important and critical attributes for document creation.
    • This document is further assembled using a template that consists of all the attributes of a contract.
    • Once the contract is assembled, it is signed and approved.
  • Edit external contracts
  • View external contract statuses to know the progress of the contract assembly
  • Update attributes and reassemble external contracts
  • Discard content from a document without deleting the document itself

Business Benefits

  • Perform process automation with rule-based authoring and assembly of clauses and documents
  • Optimize contract performance ​ with collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders for contracts
  • Ensure legal compliance​ with full traceability of signatures and responsibilities
description_zh_html:
概览

通过企业合同管理，您可以将 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 系统与外部合同汇编产品 Icertis Contract Intelligence 集成。通过此集成，用户可以创建和管理从公司中的各种业务场景生成的法律内容，例如采购流程、销售、策略或公司间协议。在所有内部和外部利益相关方达成一致并通过签名做好执行准备之前，用户可以进一步协作处理文档。

关键流程流

  • 从模板汇编合同
    • 创建交易以充当凭证创建的重要关键属性来源。
    • 此文档使用包含所有合同属性的模板进一步汇编。
    • 合同汇编后，将签署并批准。
  • 编辑外部合同
  • 查看外部合同状态，以了解合同汇编的进度
  • 更新属性并重新装配外部合同
  • 放弃文档中的内容，而不删除文档本身

业务优势

  • 通过基于规则的条款和文档的编写和汇编，执行流程自动化
  • 通过与内部和外部合同利益相关方协作，优化合同绩效
  • 确保法律合规性​ 完全追溯签名和职责
